name: Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana
nodalDept: Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Department
briefDescription: "Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides a direct cash transfer of ₹ 1,000/- for purchasing a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.
descriptionMd: "Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides a direct cash transfer of ₹ 1,000 to the bank account of the registered beneficiaries/members of the board, for purchasing a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be domiciled in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should be a registered Construction Worker (Nirmaan Shramik) or a Member of the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masons, carpenters, electricians, porters, painters, etc.
1. The applicant should have worked for at least 90 days.
1. The applicant should not already have availed of the benefits of this scheme.
